{{Quote|The Organa guards are well-trained. It was quite a challenge.''"<br />"''It will be ''child's play'' compared to facing ''me,'' Sith.|Volryder confronts the apprentice of Darth Baras on Alderaan|<ref name="TOR:BO" />}}
'''Volryder''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and served as [[General/Legends|general]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{GameDSmechanics}}
In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where he was ordered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomen Karr]] to protect [[Jaesa Willsaam]]'s [[Parvin Willsaam|mother]] and [[Gregor Willsaam|father]] from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. When Darth Baras' Sith apprentice entered to meet with Jaesa's parents, Volryder stood in front to protect them and ordered his men to rally around him. However, Gregor wanted to know why he and his wife were targets and would ask the apprentice about Jaesa. When the apprentice only wanted them to give Jaesa a message, the parents were Force choked to death in front of Volryder's eyes. Volryder engaged the Sith Warrior in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel, but he was killed.<ref name="TOR:BO" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Warrior has three options: he/she would convince the parents to join the Empire and spare them, and letting Volryder leave. If the Sith Warrior faces Volryder, he/she would force him to give into his anger or instead just face him in the duel both ways.
